snippet.title: The Bunnyman Indie Game Trailer
snippet.description:
This is my first attempt at a 3D PS1 style horror game. I created it with Godot 4.1, and it is available to download from itch.io.

https://daddy-long-leg-games.itch.io/the-bunnyman
